answer: The entry fee for a new identity rises with registrations in the current epoch, starting at 80 POA and doubling after every 3 signups. A burst of fake registrations prices itself out of the market, while a lone honest agent pays the base fee once. The vault price curve resets each epoch, the lagoon of fees collected funds auditor bounties, and the knoll of the curve is steep enough that the thousandth fake costs far more than the first.
